module: Road design standards shared by several editor tools. Defines six ordered presets, from the most rigorous to the most rustic, each with four constraints: maximum longitudinal slope (ratio), minimum curvature radius (m), maximum banking (degrees) and maximum width gradient.
usage:
local rds = extensions.editor_toolUtilities_roadDesignStandards
for _, name in ipairs(rds.getPresetStrings()) do
  local p = rds.getPresetsMap()[name]
  print(name, p.maxSlope, p.minRadius, p.maxBanking, p.maxWidthGradient)
end
notes: Presets (maxSlope / minRadius / maxBanking / maxWidthGradient): Freeway / Autobahn 0.04 / 500 / 5 / 0.02; Major Rural Road 0.06 / 200 / 7 / 0.03; Secondary Road 0.08 / 100 / 9 / 0.05; Mountain Pass 0.12 / 40 / 12 / 0.07; Unpaved Trail 0.18 / 20 / 14 / 0.10; Off-Road / F-Road 0.24 / 12 / 18 / 0.12.
Units: maxSlope as a rise/distance ratio, minRadius in meters, maxBanking in degrees.
The functions return the internal tables (not copies): do not modify them.

getPresetStrings.desc: Returns the ordered array of preset names.

getPresetsMap.desc: Returns the table preset name -> parameters {maxSlope, minRadius, maxBanking, maxWidthGradient}.
